musica.prompt: Warm, curious and playful instrumental for a premium smart-home lifestyle commercial on a sunny, quiet Florida afternoon: soft acoustic guitar, light felt piano and gentle pizzicato, around 95 BPM, a light sense of mystery at the start that stays soft and hushed in the middle (a sleeping dog) and turns warm and happy when someone arrives home, clean mix, no vocals, gentle fading ending.

The dog sleeps curled up on his bed in the corner by the front door.

escenas.prompt: The pet camera pans slowly and its small light turns on.
The robot vacuum glides slowly across the tile floor.
Empty, spotless living room with afternoon sun coming in diagonally.
The dog sits in front of the closed front door, wagging his tail.

Static camera, far shot of the entrance hall. The woman in the light blue scrub uniform, carrying a white tote bag, walks slowly forward away from the closed front door into the room, seen from behind at a three-quarter angle. The happy pit bull trots beside her, tail wagging, looking up at her. Nothing else changes: same room, same closed door, same dog bed, same sofa, same sunlight on the clean tile floor. No one else appears.
